Maximum Technologies, Inc. is committed to making its website accessible to all people, including those with disabilities. We view accessibility as part of building trustworthy technology, and we work to improve the experience for all users on an ongoing basis.

## Conformance target

We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, Level AA. These guidelines are the internationally recognized standard for making web content usable by people with a wide range of disabilities.

There may be content on this website that may not yet fully meet the standard, and we are actively working to identify and resolve those areas.

## Feedback

We welcome feedback on the accessibility of our website. If you encounter a barrier, or need information from this site in a different format, please contact us at [accessibility@maximum.com](mailto:accessibility@maximum.com).
